licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later (README badge; SPDX header in src/gui/touchcontrols.cpp; hud.lua has no licence header)
best_idea: A HUD element is data plus a show gate plus the list of events that refresh only it, and a bar that goes idle lingers one second before removal and is cancelled if the value recovers.
decision_why: Take the show-gate-then-add/change/remove order and the event-routed refresh, with the linger as a data field; reject the Lua host API and the pixel offsets, because Frankendom's HUD layout is owned by the client view.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone the breath-style bar appears only while below max, stays for 1.0 s after reaching full, then disappears; a unit test asserts removal at 1.0 s, cancellation when the value drops below max first, and a health value with hpMax = 0 renders 0 with no NaN.
